steps.name: What the standalone player is
steps.description: The standalone player is a chrome-free bundle — no extension needed, just a script you add to your page and it replays your tour automatically.

annotations.text: The standalone player is a chrome-free bundle — no extension needed, just a script you add to your page and it replays your tour automatically.

steps.name: What you need first
steps.description: You need two things: a scenario JSON (the tour itself from the extension) and a static server to serve it over HTTP — file:// won't work.

annotations.text: You need two things: a scenario JSON (the tour itself from the extension) and a static server to serve it over HTTP — file:// won't work.

steps.name: Quick start — your first replay
steps.description: Import the bundle, fetch your tour file, then call load and play. That's all it takes to replay a tour on your page.

annotations.text: Import the bundle, fetch your tour file, then call load and play. That's all it takes to replay a tour on your page.

steps.name: Where the bundle comes from
steps.description: Download the bundle right from this site — choose either a single UMD file or ESM files together, depending on how your page loads modules.

annotations.text: Download the bundle right from this site — choose either a single UMD file or ESM files together, depending on how your page loads modules.

steps.name: Optional configuration
steps.description: Set window.__MANUSCRIPT_PLAYER__ before the bundle loads to turn on text-to-speech narration, pick a voice, or set up cross-origin tour support.

annotations.text: Set window.__MANUSCRIPT_PLAYER__ before the bundle loads to turn on text-to-speech narration, pick a voice, or set up cross-origin tour support.

steps.name: Multi-page tours on one site
steps.description: A tour can walk visitors across several pages of the same site — the player handles navigation, sessionStorage carries the progress, and the next page resumes automatically.

annotations.text: A tour can walk visitors across several pages of the same site — the player handles navigation, sessionStorage carries the progress, and the next page resumes automatically.

steps.name: Crossing to another origin (advanced)
steps.description: Cross-origin tours use a presence handoff via query parameter instead of sessionStorage — both sides load the bundle and allowedParentOrigins must list the source.

annotations.text: Cross-origin tours use a presence handoff via query parameter instead of sessionStorage — both sides load the bundle and allowedParentOrigins must list the source.

steps.name: API reference
steps.description: The player exports load, play, pause, next, prev, jump, exit, onExit, resumeIfActive, and bootResume — all safe to call anytime, with no guard needed.

annotations.text: The player exports load, play, pause, next, prev, jump, exit, onExit, resumeIfActive, and bootResume — all safe to call anytime, with no guard needed.

steps.name: Keyboard during playback
steps.description: Arrow keys move between steps, Space pauses or resumes, and Esc exits the tour — presenters never need to reach for the mouse.

annotations.text: Arrow keys move between steps, Space pauses or resumes, and Esc exits the tour — presenters never need to reach for the mouse.

steps.name: When something doesn't play
steps.description: Check that you're serving over HTTP not file://, all three ESM files are together, the page hasn't changed since authoring, and every page in a multi-page tour has the bundle.

annotations.text: Check that you're serving over HTTP not file://, all three ESM files are together, the page hasn't changed since authoring, and every page in a multi-page tour has the bundle.

steps.name: Try it — right here on this page
steps.description: This guide embeds the player and tours itself — press play and a spotlight walks across key sections with no extension and no page navigation.

annotations.text: This guide embeds the player and tours itself — press play and a spotlight walks across key sections with no extension and no page navigation.
